title: Variational Principles and Machine Learning: a Numerical Analysis and PDE perspective
abstract: arXiv:2611.34314v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Variational principles have played a fundamental role in the development of modern mathematics, physics, and scientific computing. From the principles of least action in mechanics to the calculus of variations and the variational formulation of partial differential equations, they have provided a powerful framework for understanding complex problems and designing reliable numerical methods. In recent years, Machine Learning has introduced a new computational paradigm, in which highly expressive nonlinear function spaces and large-scale minimisation problems play a central role. In these notes, we explore the connection between these two frameworks. We develop a variational and numerical-analysis perspective on Machine Learning algorithms, focusing in particular on their formulation as nonlinear minimisation problems. translated_title: 变分原理与机器学习：数值分析与偏微分方程的视角
translated_abstract: 变分原理在现代数学、物理学和科学计算的发展中发挥了基础性作用。从力学中的最小作用量原理，到变分法以及偏微分方程的变分形式，它们为理解复杂问题和设计可靠的数值方法提供了强大的框架。近年来，机器学习引入了一种新的计算范式，其中高表达性的非线性函数空间和大规模最小化问题扮演着核心角色。在这些讲义中，我们探讨了这两种框架之间的联系。我们从变分和数值分析的角度审视机器学习算法，特别关注其作为非线性最小化问题的表述形式。我们研究了稳定性、一致性、可逼近性和紧性等经典概念如何在机器学习中获得新的诠释。
tldr: 本文从数值分析与偏微分方程的变分视角出发，将机器学习算法视为非线性最小化问题加以研究，探讨稳定性、一致性、可逼近性和紧性等经典数值分析概念在机器学习中的新内涵。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a variational and numerical-analysis perspective on machine learning algorithms, formulated as nonlinear minimisation problems, investigating how classical concepts such as stability, consistency, approximability, and compactness acquire new interpretations.
